# Lifecycle And Retention Checklist: Retention And Deletion Execution

**Purpose**: Validate deletion state machine, retention eligibility, local purge, dependency truth, and report requirements before task generation.
**Created**: 2026-06-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Lifecycle Coverage

- [x] CHK001 Are top-level deletion states specified from request through deleting, active purge complete, backup pending, complete, retryable failed, terminal failed, policy blocked, post-egress limit, and local purge unverified? [Completeness, Spec FR-004]
- [x] CHK002 Are per-artifact states specified for controlled, external, local device, backup, post-egress, and not-applicable classes? [Completeness, Data Model §MeetingDeletionArtifactState]
- [x] CHK003 Are state transitions clear enough to prevent duplicate active deletion requests for one meeting? [Clarity, Data Model §State Transitions]
- [x] CHK004 Are server purge completion, backup expiry completion, and local purge acknowledgement kept as separate report concepts? [Consistency, Spec US3/US4]

## Retention Coverage

- [x] CHK005 Are retention eligibility rules specified for expired, retained, processing, already deleting, already deleted, policy blocked, and unsafe-config meetings? [Coverage, Spec US2/FR-013/FR-014]
- [x] CHK006 Is policy snapshotting required so later review can explain why a retention action occurred? [Completeness, Research Decision 4]
- [x] CHK007 Are dry-run/operator scan outcomes represented without exposing private meeting content? [Clarity, OpenAPI RetentionRunResponse]

## Local Purge Coverage

- [x] CHK008 Are local purge tasks created for relevant registered devices without requiring the desktop to reveal local paths or file proof? [Coverage, Spec FR-010/FR-011]
- [x] CHK009 Are acknowledged, pending, unreachable, failed, expired, and local-expiry-relied-upon states measurable? [Measurability, Spec SC-006]
- [x] CHK010 Are late acknowledgements allowed to update report truth without rewriting prior server purge evidence? [Consistency, Local Purge Contract]

## Dependency Truth Coverage

- [x] CHK011 Are MediaScribe unsupported/unknown states treated as truthful limits rather than blockers that get hidden from the report? [Clarity, Spec FR-015]
- [x] CHK012 Is Langfuse metadata-only state distinct from future content-bearing trace deletion requirements? [Clarity, Spec FR-016]
- [x] CHK013 Are downloads, exports, and external integrations represented as post-egress limits that cannot be technically revoked? [Completeness, Spec FR-017]

## Notes

- Lifecycle and retention checklist passes. Requirements are specific enough to generate dependency-ordered implementation tasks.
